The '''Aratech Ionmaster''' was the most advanced [[Ion blaster/Legends|ion blaster]] produced by the [[Aratech Repulsor Company/Legends|Aratech Company]] as of the [[Jedi Civil War]]. This weapon was designed for multiple-purpose use, though it was generally less damaging against organic opponents. However, ion weapons were able to penetrate some defenses that would have blocked typical [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire.
